bio_en: Movses Gyulnazarian was born in Oshakan in 1896 and studied at the Gevorgian seminary, which he left in 1915 to join the Armenian volunteers. After the volunteer units were dissolved he attended the officers' school in Tiflis, served on the Western front, won the Cross of St George and fought at Tarnopol. When the Bolsheviks deported the Armenian officers in January 1921, he escaped, and on 18 February 1921 he led the people's fighters advancing from the south on Yerevan. He was killed in the gardens of Yerevan on the bank of the Hrazdan.
